audited_source_corrections.action: Removed the redundant Sigma premise set from the non-derivability side of the consistency equivalence while retaining Sigma as the modal-system index.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The surrounding claim concerns theoremhood relative to modal system Sigma and consistency of the singleton premise A, but the parenthetical equivalence alone also inserts Sigma itself as a premise set.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் $\Proves/[\Sigma] \lnot !A$ என்பதையும் $!A \Proves/[\Sigma] \lfalse$ என்பதையும் ஒப்பிட்டு, Sigma-வை முறைமைச் சுட்டியாக மட்டும் வைத்திருக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Treating every axiom formula in Sigma as an additional premise despite their already being derivable in the indexed system; changing the singleton-consistency side.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The immediately preceding and following sentences use empty-premise Sigma-relative theoremhood, and the cited consistency definition makes A consistent exactly when A does not derive false in that same system.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the corrected equivalence compare empty-premise Sigma-relative non-theoremhood with consistency of A?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the completeness consequence from A in Gamma to not-A in Gamma when A is absent.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The second half of the negation biconditional assumes A is absent but concludes A is present, contradicting both completeness and the stated result.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping the direct contradiction as the claimed consequence of completeness; reversing the stated biconditional.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Completeness requires that each formula or its negation belongs to Gamma, so absence of A forces membership of not-A.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the corrected reverse direction conclude membership of not-A from absence of A?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the converse assumption from absence of A-implies-B to absence of A-iff-B.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The proof is the converse direction of the biconditional-membership clause and immediately infers membership of not-(A iff B), but its assumption names only A implies B.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மறுதிசை வாதத்தை $!A \liff !B \notin \Gamma$ என்ற பொருத்தமான கருதுகோளுடன் தொடங்குகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping a conditional premise that cannot yield the next negated biconditional; rewriting the entire proof as a conditional-only result.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Completeness turns absence of the exact formula A iff B into membership of its negation, which is the premise used in the remaining argument.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the corrected converse assume absence of the same biconditional whose negation is used next?
